forbidden: automatic retry or replacement of any real phase

gate1c_private_bundle.old_paths: Existing HOME compatibility symlinks resolve to NAS; original metadata remains untouched
gate1c_private_bundle.verification: Full manifest SHA, canonical content hash, exact logical path/count/byte coverage and every file SHA256 before any private tensor/array use; recheck unchanged at final seal

inputs.stage_matrices: The nine immutable B0 checkpoint descriptors preserve their published stage matrices; historical values are provenance only and never sampled or used as outcomes in PMGC. No test GT file is opened.

case_selection: Read only published train/val case metadata; all training labeled cases are used. Validation selects 16 distinct cases by the fixed SHA256 rank per unit/side, before any model read; eight ordered batches of two; previous means immediately preceding domain only.

mode_fit.source: previous-stage best EMA applied to current-domain train_labeled
mode_fit.fit_coordinates: Exact inherited Gate1A sampling plan current-domain train_labeled coordinates; no resampling
mode_fit.case_pixel_balancing: Equal mass per nonempty case/class, equal mass per sampled pixel within that case/class; retain original weights and null rows; fit only active rows using unchanged di_dmpa_gate1_v2.geometry.fit
mode_fit.initialization_and_ties: Unchanged Gate1A weighted kmeans++ / residual reseed by UID rank / lowest-index nearest cosine tie / first strictly lowest-Q restart
mode_fit.assignment: All valid full-resolution current train_labeled pixels: argmax cosine to active frozen class K2 centers, lowest slot tie; null remains unassigned. Frozen centers are diagnostic guards, never segmentation predictions.
mode_fit.occupancy: full-resolution active class pixels in mode / all active pixels of that class in the same current labeled panel

guards.panel: All current train_labeled cases in the fixed unit; guard gradients aggregated once and reused for that unit, before either real integration or formal pair projection.
guards.current_loss: Mean CE over all active labeled pixels in the frozen class/mode. The global pair supervised CE includes null pixels and every valid class.
guards.old_loss: Mean forward KL(stopgrad(native FP32 old posterior-mean probability) || FP64 current stochastic student probability) on active mode pixels where old argmax equals visible train_labeled GT; no confidence threshold.
guards.inactive_KD: Omit that K2 constraint, do not fabricate or merge it. Compute its graph-connected sum/normalizer VJP even if inactive to keep a fixed graph and to define the independent K1 class comparator.
guards.global_constraint: Exact labeled-cycle supervised gradient of this fixed B0 pair
guards.panel_VJP: Per-batch numerator divided by fixed whole-panel support for that mode, sum batch VJPs. Six supervised plus six old-function VJPs per batch, including explicit connected zeros when a batch has no pixels.

parameter_inventory.None_gradient: explicit zero placeholder for every None, record mask and name; all 51 tensors retained

guards.P2: Global pair supervised plus 3 class-level current and 3 class-level old guards. K1 fit uses the same features/weights; the class support is the union of its two active K2 supports (same null exclusions). Class means are exact count-weighted sums of mode means; old class guard active at >=32 total old-correct pixels. This is only the fixed K1 control, never a primary mode merge.

raw_gradient.objective: labeled-cycle supervised CE + 0.5 * original repaired-B0 PAS probability consistency
raw_gradient.PAS: Original joint student/teacher native FP32 PAS validity and teacher probability, exact frozen draw0 teacher and two student seeds, same-Gaussian FP64 VJPs; no new ranking/filtering/reweighting.
raw_gradient.precision: Native FP32 teacher/PAS/gaussian define the repaired B0 objective. P0 and guards use the existing FP64 shadow of the same frozen parameters, same captured native Gaussian. Native supervised and total-B0 VJPs are retained as precision controls.

native_FP64_parity.scope: global supervised and total B0 VJP per pair; failure blocks, never a scientific rescue

raw_gradient.GAS_forward: unchanged official classifier, no state update

projection.conditioning: Normalize each nonzero h by its positive Euclidean norm only; retain raw vectors/dots and explicit zero constraints.
projection.solver: Deterministic exhaustive KKT active-set certification in ascending subset cardinality and lexicographic guard-index order; symmetric Gram eigendecomposition/pseudoinverse; first sufficiently certified candidate; no ridge, no fallback, no threshold tuning.
projection.dual_policy: Reject lambda<-1e-12; clamp only remaining roundoff-negative multipliers to zero and recertify every condition.
projection.rank_and_condition: Report full normalized Gram rank, effective positive-spectrum condition; full condition is structurally undefined for rank-deficient systems and serialized null with an explicit reason, never infinity/NaN.
projection.determinism: Repeat complete solver twice on identical arrays; direction and dual arrays must be bitwise equal.
projection.zero_direction: Keep fixed pair/candidate denominator, flag invalid normalized virtual step and G6 failure, evaluate identity only as explicitly marked diagnostic; never divide by epsilon or call feasible zero useful.

comparators.P2: global + K1 class current + K1 class old
comparators.P4: global + active K2 current + active K2 old; PRIMARY

virtual_step.stateless: torch.func.functional_call on the immutable FP64 shadow with freshly derived detached parameter tensors, cloned unchanged buffers, strict=True; no optimizer, parameter assignment, checkpoint write or update.
virtual_step.precision: FP64 parameters/forward for before and after; no rounded FP32 perturbation.
virtual_step.validation_classifier: posterior_mean, stochastic_classifier=False; itemized seeds are set for reproducibility but must consume no random classifier draw.
virtual_step.training_guard_classifier: stochastic_classifier=True, replay exactly the native FP32 Gaussian captured for each fixed guard batch in preparation.
virtual_step.baseline: One immutable before evaluator panel per unit, reused identically for all pairs/candidates/phases. Native previous-EMA val output only assigns evaluator strata/old targets. Val GT is never passed to guard construction, QP or candidate code.
virtual_step.panels: Every candidate of every integration/formal pair evaluates every registered previous/current validation batch and every current train_labeled guard batch.
required_outputs: supported per-K2-mode CE and conditional Dice
virtual_step.CE: Sum cross entropy over valid pixels / number of valid pixels; per class and mode use their own fixed support. Same support across all candidates. No case reweighting in CE losses.
virtual_step.Dice: Exact argmax confusion matrix pooled over the full panel. Dice_c=2*TP_c/(GT_c+pred_c); foreground macro averages classes1/2. Zero denominator is explicit undefined, never imputed. Conditional mode Dice uses the same formula restricted to its evaluator mode pixels and is descriptive.
virtual_step.mode_strata: Apply frozen old centers to previous/current val old-EMA features conditional on evaluator GT; evaluator-only. Nonempty foreground modes define a fixed candidate-independent support set for worst-mode CE. Report every unsupported mode explicitly, never drop a pair; if no supported FG mode exists the required comparison is undefined/fails.
virtual_step.delta: after minus identical before; improvement(control, P4)=control_delta-P4_delta. Positive means lower loss / larger Dice where stated.

P4_vs_P2.worst_mode_previous_loss: max(afterCE-beforeCE) over supported FG K2 modes in that pair/unit
P4_vs_P2.positive_unit: median of its eight worst-mode improvements >0

G6.transition: stage1 or stage2 across 24 formal pairs; also report all six unit medians

decision.missing_required_value: Do not filter denominator or impute. Required comparison fails; missing/corrupted engineering artifact BLOCKED_INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE.

call_graph.compiler: After exact code commit push and remote verification, run the same kernels on explicit synthetic models/tensors, including real inventory-shaped model if needed; dynamically count model forwards and torch.autograd.grad, bind source SHA, assert stage-specific graph. Freeze compiler receipt before any real forward.

one K2/K1 fit per class/unit (0 forwards/autograd)

isolated previous/current validation old mean and FP64 before cache (96+96 forwards,0 VJPs)
pair_order: native supervised,total and FP64 supervised,total (4 autograd calls)

call_graph.unsupported_mode_graph: Every one of twelve guard VJP slots executes per guard batch, using a graph-connected zero when its selected support is empty; inactive/zero constraints remain explicit and do not add/remove calls.
call_graph.scientific_zero_direction_graph: Identity diagnostic still executes all preregistered evaluator forwards; step_valid=false and G6 fails.
